chapter.verse: asian leh Topa Jesu Khris ii sila James in a kithehthang beh sawmlenihte kong hopih hi.
Ka sanggamte aw, haksatna namkim na tuah uh ciangin lungdamna bekbekin na la un.
A hang pen na upna uh hong kisittel ciangin tua in thuakzawhna piangsak cih na thei uh hi.
Note, kitangsap nei lo-in a cingtaak na suah theih nadingun thuakzawhna ii a nasep hong cingtaak ta hen.
Note' lakah khatpeuh pilna a kitangsam a om leh kuamah a simmawh lo, vekpi' tungah cingh takin a guan, Pasian' kiangah ngen ta hen. Tua hileh amah kipia ding hi.
Ahi zongin muanlahna nei lo-in upna tawh ngen ta hen. A muanglah mi pen huih' mutin a kilok tuipi tuihual tawh kibang hi.
Tua bang mi in Topa' kiangpan na khatpeuh ngahkha dingin a ki-upmawh loh ding ahi hi.
Lungheinei mi, sepna peuh ah thu a khel themthum mi ahih man hi.
Sanggam a tualniammi, amah a kilapsangna ah kipak kisial henla
mihaumi, amah a kiniambawlna ah kipak kisial ta hen. A hang pen lopa pak bangin amah a mangthang pah ding ahi hi.
Ni suakin hong sat mahmah ciangin lopa keu-in a pakte pulh a, a hoihna teng beimang hi. Tua mah bangin mihaumi zong a zon a vaih kikalin a maimang ding ahi hi.
Zia-etna a tuahkhak laitak a dingkip mi thuphangah ahi hi. A hang pen zia-etna a zawhsiang khit ciangin amah in Pasian a itte' tunga kamciam kipia ahi nuntakna lukhu ngah ding hi.
Siatzolna a tuakkha mi kuamahpeuh in, “Pasian' siatzol ka tuahkhak laitak hi,” ci kei hen. A hang pen thusia tawh Pasian kisiatzol theilo ahih mah bangin amahmah in zong kuamah siatzol lo hi.
Ahi zongin mi khat ciat, ama' lunggulh thute in a zol a kaih ciangin siatzolna a tuak ahi hi.
Tua ciangin lunggulhna hong gai-in mawhna suakkhia a, mawhna hong khangcin ciangin sihna piangsak hi.
Kong it sanggamte aw, khem thuakkha kei un.
Piakkhiatna a hoih khempeuh leh khuttawi a cingtaak khempeuh pen tunglam pan hi a, kiheina hangin kilaih kiliah cih bang a omlo, khuavak pianna Pa' kiangpan hong paisuk ahi hi.
Ama' piansakte' lakah anpal bangin a masapen i suah theih nadingin Pasian in ama' ut thu-in thumaan thutak pulakna tawh eite hong piangsak hi.
Kong it sanggamte aw, hih thu thei ta un. Mi kim, thungaih ding lamah manlang henla paukhiat ding lam leh hehsuah ding lamah ziakai ta hen.
A hang pen mihing' hehna in Pasian' dikna thu piangsak lo hi.
Tua hi a, a thanghuai namkim leh a luanglet khansiatna nusia unla, na nunna kha uh hong honkhia thei, note' sunga hong kisuan Pasian' thu, lungnemna tawh sang un.
Tu-in nomaumah kikhemkhem kei unla, thu a ngai ciang bek hilo-in thu za-in a zuite hita un.
A hang pen mi khatpeuh, thu a ngai ciang bek hi henla zui tuanlo hileh limlang panin a pianpih a maitang a vel mi tawh kibang hi.
A hang pen amahmah a kivel khit ciangin paikhia a, a mel bangci om cih mangngilh pah hi.

Ahi zongin suahtakna tawh kisai a cingtaak thukhun a entel bek hilo-in a zuisuak mi ahihleh thu ngai-a a mangngilh nam hilo, thu zui-in a semkhia nam ahihna tungtawnin a sep a bawlna ah thupha ngah ding hi.
Mi khatpeuh amahmah biaknami kisa hinapi kampau a kikep zawh keileh amahmah a lungsim a kikhem hi a, ama' biakna neih a taanglamlo ahi hi.

Pa Pasian' mai-ah a siangtho, ninbaanglo biakna i cih pen hih bang hi: Tagahte leh meigong numeite amau' haksat hun ciangin vehna donna, leh leitung siatna tawh kisawhkhak loh nadingin eimahmah kikepna, ahi hi.
